stem:
The graph shows a relationship between x and y.

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The graph shows a non-proportional relationship because the graph has a negative slope.

options.label: B
options.text: The graph shows a non-proportional relationship because the graph does not contain the origin.

options.label: C
options.text: The graph shows a proportional relationship because the x and y intercepts both contain 7.

options.label: D
options.text: The graph shows a proportional relationship because the graph passes through 3 different quadrants.

visual_elements: graph with line crossing y-axis at 7 and x-axis at 7 with negative slope passing through quadrants I, II, and IV
